explanation.heading: Why this was flagged
explanation.text: Payment of USD 25,000.00 to Invoice 4711 was released with 1 distinct approver; 2 are required above USD 25,000. The release carried a single approval while the amount sits at the two-approver threshold.

explanation.heading: Why it matters
explanation.text: A payment at or above USD 5,000 needs one approver who is not the requester; at or above USD 25,000 it needs two distinct approvers. The policy also separates the requester: two approvals from the same person count as one.

paragraphs.heading: Finding
paragraphs.text: Payment of USD 25,000.00 to Invoice 4711 was released with 1 distinct approver; 2 are required above USD 25,000.

paragraphs.heading: Impact
paragraphs.text: Risk score 35 with severity high. Review due by Mar 2, 09:00. A payment above the two-approver threshold moved to release with one approval on record.

paragraphs.heading: Corrective action
paragraphs.text: Record the second approver's decision and the corrected payment evidence, then close this finding with a reason.
